extension.summary: First-run installer for a lean Real-Debrid + Trakt Kodi build
extension.description: Installs upstream repositories and core add-ons for a Netflix-style movies/TV setup: Arctic Fuse 3, Red Light (Real-Debrid + Trakt; Fen Light AM if still listed), and CocoScrapers. Then walks through Real-Debrid, Trakt, scraper enablement, and applies TMDb Helper home widgets. Does not install live TV, music, or arcade packs.
extension.disclaimer: Does not host or provide video content. You must supply your own Real-Debrid and Trakt accounts. Not affiliated with Kodi, Fen, CocoScrapers, jurialmunkey, Red Wizard, or CocoJoe.
extension.news: 1.0.2 - Apply Netflix-style Arctic Fuse 3 home widgets via TMDb Helper (no local library)
